app_description: Share files, code, and links securely and temporarily
auth_sign_in_description: Sign in to send and receive files, snippets, and links.
auth_sign_up_description: Sign up to send and receive files, snippets, and links.
auth_username_too_short: Username must be at least {min} characters
auth_username_too_long: Username must be at most {max} characters
auth_username_invalid_chars: Username may only contain letters, digits, _ and -, and must start with a letter or digit
auth_password_breached: This password has appeared in a data breach. Choose a different one.
auth_password_rule_mixed_case: An uppercase and a lowercase letter
auth_password_rule_symbol: A symbol (a space does not count)
auth_password_reset_invalid_link: The password reset link is invalid or missing
auth_password_reset_success: Password has been reset. Please sign in with your new password.
auth_forgot_password_description: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to reset it.
auth_reset_link_sent_description: If that address has an account, a password reset link is on its way.
auth_reset_request_throttled: Too many requests. Try again in {minutes} min.
auth_reset_request_unavailable: This instance can't send email right now.
upload_share_description: Upload a file, paste code, or shorten a link.
upload_result_delete_confirm_description: This removes the link and its content immediately. This can't be undone.
home_description: The default locale is set to Traditional Chinese.
home_subtitle: This app uses the shared monorepo i18n package.
share_retrieve_description: Enter the code you were given.
share_not_found_description: This code doesn't match any share. It may have been mistyped.
share_gone_description: It expired or has already been retrieved as many times as it allows.
share_rate_limited_description: Slow down and try again in a moment.
share_locked_description: Enter the password to view this share.
share_no_preview: No preview available for this file
share_preview_too_large: Too large to preview — download it instead
user_page_description: Manage your profile, password, and active sessions
user_sessions_description: Where this account has been signed in. Sessions that have already ended are listed too, so you can tell whether anyone else has been in.
user_sessions_revoke_confirm_description: That device is signed out immediately and has to sign in again to use this account.
user_coming_soon: This feature is not available yet
user_profile_description: Update your username and email address
user_profile_current_password_hint: Enter your current password to confirm it's you before changing your name or email.
user_profile_taken: That name or email is already in use
user_profile_email_unverified: Your new email address hasn't been verified yet.
user_email_verification_sent: Sent. Open the link in your inbox.
user_email_verification_throttled: Too many emails sent. Try again in {minutes} min.
user_email_verification_unavailable: Email can't be sent right now. Try again later.
user_verify_email_done_description: This address is now confirmed as yours.
user_verify_email_unusable: This link can't be used. It may have expired or already been used; send a new one from your account settings.
user_verify_email_missing: This link is incomplete. Open it again from the email.
user_passkeys_description: Sign in securely without a password
user_danger_description: Actions that affect every device, some of them permanent
user_danger_revoke_description: Revoke every active connection except this device. Useful if you forgot to sign out somewhere.
user_danger_delete_description: Permanently remove this account and sign out every device. This can't be undone.
user_danger_delete_confirm_description: Enter your current password to confirm. A deleted account can't be restored.
user_danger_delete_shares_on: Every link you've handed out stops working immediately.
user_danger_delete_shares_off: Links you've handed out keep working until they expire.
user_danger_delete_admin_notice: You're an administrator. If you're the last person who can administer this server, give that permission to another account before deleting.
user_danger_delete_last_admin: You're the last person who can administer this server. Give the permission to another account first.
user_prefs_time_format_description: How times are displayed for this account
user_prefs_theme_description: The theme is stored for the current user only.
user_prefs_app_theme_description: Pick the overall visual theme. It applies everywhere.
user_prefs_app_theme_graphite_descriptio: Cool-toned interface with tighter, lower-contrast layers.
user_prefs_app_theme_sepia_description: Warm paper tones, easier on long reading sessions.
user_prefs_app_theme_matsu_description: Warm paper with an olive cast, soft like hand-drawn animation.
user_prefs_app_theme_cosmic_description: Deep blue-violet, at its best in dark mode.
user_prefs_app_theme_slate_description: Clean cool grey that stays out of the way.
user_prefs_app_theme_vintage_description: Low-contrast tea-stained paper, like old print.
user_prefs_accent_description: Pick an accent color to personalize the interface
user_prefs_save_failed: Could not save your appearance preference.
oidc_error_generic: That sign-in did not go through. Please try again.
oidc_error_unavailable: That sign-in method is not set up on this site, or could not be reached. Try another way in.
oidc_error_stale: That sign-in took too long, or the link had already been used. Please start again.
oidc_error_refused: The provider refused the sign-in. Please try again, or use another way in.
oidc_error_no_address: The provider did not give us a verified email address, and an account needs one. Verify your address with them, then try again.
oidc_error_not_permitted: Your account is not in a group this site allows. Ask an administrator for access.
oidc_error_not_invited: This site is not open for sign-ups. You need an invitation to create an account here.
oidc_error_address_taken: An account here already uses that email address. Sign in with your password, then link the provider from your account page.
oidc_error_disabled: That account has been disabled. Please contact an administrator.
oidc_error_already_linked: That account is already linked to somebody else here.
user_identities_description: Other accounts you can sign in to Tessera with.
user_identities_error: Could not load your sign-in methods.
user_identities_none_configured: This site has no third-party sign-in set up.
user_identities_last_way_in: This is the only way into your account. Add a password or another method before unlinking it.
auth_invite_description: This site is invite-only. Ask whoever runs it for a code.
auth_registration_closed_description: This site is not taking new accounts. If you already have one, sign in — including with a third-party account you have linked.
auth_register_pending_description: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Open it to finish creating your account.
auth_register_confirm_missing_token_desc: Open this page from the link in your confirmation email.
auth_register_confirm_link_unusable_desc: The confirmation link is unknown, already used, or expired. Sign up again to get a new one.
auth_register_confirm_closed_description: This site stopped taking new accounts while this link was waiting to be used.
auth_register_confirm_taken_description: Someone else registered that username while this link was waiting. Sign up again with a different one.
auth_register_confirm_generic_descriptio: Something went wrong. Sign up again to get a new confirmation link.
